translations.web: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
translations.bsb: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
translations.kjv: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
translations.asv: So that with good courage we say, The Lord is my helper; I will not fear: What shall man do unto me?
